gear.name: Alchemist's Lab
gear.text: Needed to Craft alchemical items during downtime. Takes 2 hands to use.

gear.name: Alchemist's Toolkit
gear.text: A mobile collection of vials and chemicals for simple alchemical tasks. Usable with 1 hand if worn, or 2 if held.

gear.name: Artisan's Toolkit
gear.text: Needed to create items from raw materials with the Craft skill; different sets suit different trades. Usable with 1 hand if worn, or 2 if held.

gear.name: Backpack
gear.text: Holds up to 4 Bulk of items; the first 2 Bulk inside don't count against your Bulk limits. Light Bulk if carried rather than worn.

gear.name: Barding (Light; Small or Medium)
gear.text: Light armor for a Small or Medium animal: +1 AC, Dex cap +5, check penalty -1, Speed penalty -5 ft., Strength +3.

gear.name: Barding (Light; Large)
gear.text: Light armor for a Large animal: +1 AC, Dex cap +5, check penalty -1, Speed penalty -5 ft., Strength +3.

gear.name: Basic Crafter's Book
gear.text: Contains the formulas for Crafting the common level-0 items of the equipment chapter.

gear.name: Bedroll
gear.text: Portable bedding for resting in the field.

gear.name: Brass Ear
gear.text: A flared listening tube. A door, window, or thin wall increases your Perception DC to hear sounds beyond it by only half as much as normal.

gear.name: Caltrops
gear.text: Four-pronged spikes scattered into an adjacent square with an Interact action; the first creature to move in must succeed at a DC 14 Acrobatics check or take 1d4 piercing damage and 1 persistent bleed damage.

gear.name: Candle
gear.text: A lit candle sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius for 8 hours.

gear.name: Chain (10 feet)
gear.text: 10 feet of sturdy metal chain.

gear.name: Chalk (10)
gear.text: 10 pieces of writing chalk.

gear.name: Chest
gear.text: A wooden chest that holds up to 8 Bulk of items.

gear.name: Climbing Kit
gear.text: Rope, pulleys, a dozen pitons, a hammer, a grappling hook, and crampons for one climber. Anchors you while Climbing at half Speed; on a critical failure, attempt a DC 5 flat check to prevent the fall.

gear.name: Clothing (Ordinary)
gear.text: Functional garb with basic tailoring, such as work clothes.

gear.name: Clothing (Cold-Weather)
gear.text: Insulated clothing for travel in cold climates.

gear.name: Clothing (Explorer's)
gear.text: Sturdy travel clothing that can be reinforced to protect you even though it isn't armor; see the armor entry of the same name.

gear.name: Clothing (Fine)
gear.text: Fashionable, expensive clothing suited to high society.

gear.name: Compass
gear.text: Helps you Sense Direction or navigate; without one you take a -2 item penalty to those checks.

gear.name: Cookware
gear.text: Pots, pans, and utensils for preparing meals.

gear.name: Crowbar
gear.text: Gives leverage when Forcing Open objects without an easy grip; without one, prying something open takes a -2 item penalty to the Athletics check.

gear.name: Disguise Kit
gear.text: Cosmetics, false facial hair, spirit gum, and simple wigs, usually needed to set up a disguise to Impersonate someone with Deception.

gear.name: Disguise Kit (Replacement Cosmetics)
gear.text: Replenishes the cosmetics supply of a disguise kit.

gear.name: Dueling Cape
gear.text: Wrapped around one arm with an Interact action; you can then spend an action to hold it protectively, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and to Deception checks to Feint until the start of your next turn.

gear.name: Fishing Tackle
gear.text: A collapsible fishing pole, fishhooks, line, lures, and a fishing net.

gear.name: Flint and Steel
gear.text: Lights a fire given time to catch a spark — at least 3 actions, often much longer; typically impractical during an encounter.

gear.name: Formula Book (Blank)
gear.text: Holds the formulas needed to Craft items beyond the common equipment of this chapter; each book holds formulas for up to 100 items.

gear.name: Hammer
gear.text: A sturdy tool for driving pitons and nails.

gear.name: Hourglass
gear.text: Measures the passage of time.

gear.name: Ladder (10-foot)
gear.text: A 10-foot wooden ladder.

gear.name: Lantern (Bull's-Eye)
gear.text: Sheds bright light in a 60-foot cone (dim light in the next 60 feet); burns 1 pint of oil for 6 hours.

gear.name: Lantern (Hooded)
gear.text: Sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius (dim light in the next 30 feet); burns 1 pint of oil for 6 hours. Shutters can be closed with an Interact action to block the light.

gear.name: Lock (Poor)
gear.text: A crude lock; picking it requires two successful DC 15 Thievery checks.

gear.name: Lock (Simple)
gear.text: A simple lock; picking it requires three successful DC 20 Thievery checks.

gear.name: Manacles (Poor)
gear.text: Crude restraints for binding a creature's wrists or legs.

gear.name: Manacles (Simple)
gear.text: Simple restraints for binding a creature's wrists or legs.

gear.name: Merchant's Scale
gear.text: A balance and weights for checking goods and coinage.

gear.name: Mirror
gear.text: A small polished mirror.

gear.name: Mug
gear.text: A simple drinking vessel.

gear.name: Musical Instrument (Handheld)
gear.text: A portable instrument such as a flute, lute, fiddle, small harp, or hand drum.

gear.name: Musical Instrument (Heavy)
gear.text: A large instrument such as heavy drums, a full set of chimes, or a keyboard; generally stationary while played.

gear.name: Net
gear.text: Weighted netting, usable alone or attached to a rope; with a rope attached you can Grapple a Medium or smaller creature up to 10 feet away.

gear.name: Oil (1 pint)
gear.text: Fuels lanterns, or can be prepared with an Interact action and thrown as a ranged attack; on a hit, succeed at a DC 10 flat check to ignite it for 1d6 fire damage.

gear.name: Parrying Scabbard
gear.text: A reinforced sheath drawn alongside its one-handed sword; spend an action to position it defensively and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

gear.name: Piton
gear.text: A small spike hammered into a surface as an anchor to make climbing easier.

gear.name: Primal Symbol
gear.text: An adornment of natural materials symbolizing a connection to nature, such as a ring of woven plants or a token made from animal parts; primal spellcasters often wear one.

gear.name: Rations (1 week)
gear.text: One week of preserved food for one person.

gear.name: Religious Symbol (Wooden)
gear.text: A wooden emblem of a deity; some divine spellcasters use a religious symbol for certain abilities. Worn on a chain or pin, or held.

gear.name: Religious Symbol (Silver)
gear.text: A silver emblem of a deity; some divine spellcasters use a religious symbol for certain abilities. Worn on a chain or pin, or held.

gear.name: Religious Text
gear.text: A manuscript of scripture; some divine spellcasters use a religious text, held in one hand, for certain abilities.

gear.name: Repair Toolkit
gear.text: A portable anvil, tongs, woodworking tools, a whetstone, and conditioning oils, used to Repair items with the Crafting skill.

gear.name: Rope (50 feet)
gear.text: 50 feet of sturdy rope.

gear.name: Sack
gear.text: Holds up to 8 Bulk of items; wearable tucked into a belt when holding 2 Bulk or less. Carried with one hand, though transferring items in and out takes two.

gear.name: Saddlebags
gear.text: A pair of bags for a mount; each holds up to 3 Bulk, and the first 1 Bulk in each doesn't count against the mount's Bulk limit.

gear.name: Signal Whistle
gear.text: When sounded, it can be heard clearly up to half a mile away across open terrain.

gear.name: Soap
gear.text: For washing yourself and your belongings.

gear.name: Spellbook (Blank)
gear.text: Holds the written knowledge needed to learn and prepare spells; each spellbook can hold up to 100 spells.

gear.name: Spyglass
gear.text: Lets you see eight times farther than normal.

gear.name: Tack
gear.text: A saddle, bit and bridle, and stirrups — everything needed to outfit a riding animal. Bulk 2 when carried rather than worn by the animal.

gear.name: Ten-Foot Pole
gear.text: While wielding this pole you can use Seek to search a square up to 10 feet away. Not sturdy enough to use as a weapon.

gear.name: Tent (Pup)
gear.text: A small tent that sleeps one.

gear.name: Tent (Four-Person)
gear.text: A tent that sleeps up to four.

gear.name: Thieves' Toolkit
gear.text: Needed to Pick Locks or Disable Devices with the Thievery skill. Usable with 1 hand if worn, or 2 if held.

gear.name: Thieves' Toolkit (Replacement Picks)
gear.text: Replacement lock picks that fix a broken thieves' toolkit without using the Repair action.

gear.name: Tool (Long)
gear.text: A basic long hand tool such as a hoe, shovel, or sledgehammer; usable as an improvised weapon dealing 1d6 damage.

gear.name: Tool (Short)
gear.text: A basic short hand tool such as a hand drill, ice hook, or trowel; usable as an improvised weapon dealing 1d4 damage.

gear.name: Torch
gear.text: Sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (dim light in the next 20 feet) for 1 hour; as an improvised weapon it deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage plus 1 fire damage.

gear.name: Waterskin
gear.text: When full, holds roughly one day's worth of water for a Small or Medium creature.

gear.name: Writing Set
gear.text: Stationery, ink, a quill or ink pen, sealing wax, and a simple seal, for drafting correspondence and scribing scrolls.

gear.name: Writing Set (Extra Ink and Paper)
gear.text: Refills a well-used writing set.

gear.name: Cane
gear.text: A straight length of wood with a curved handle that helps with balance and takes some weight off the opposite leg; typically 2 to 3 feet long, lengthened or shortened as needed.

gear.name: Corrective Lenses
gear.text: Eyeglasses or goggles that correct vision; donned or removed with an Interact action.

gear.name: Crutch
gear.text: Fits under the armpit to support walking; used singly or as a pair depending on the support needed.

gear.name: Hearing Aid
gear.text: Worn in the ear and made from carved wood, shaped metal, or clockwork to aid those who are hard of hearing; attached or removed with an Interact action.

gear.name: Hearing Aid (Magical)
gear.text: A magical hearing aid whose receiver detects sound waves and transfers them into the ear; turned on or off with an Interact action.

gear.name: Prosthesis
gear.text: Replaces a missing or damaged body part and provides its full range of functionality; attached or removed with an Interact action.

gear.name: Wheelchair
gear.text: A common wheelchair ideal for everyday use, though not designed for strenuous activity; made in a variety of sizes.

gear.name: Wheelchair (Traveler's Chair)
gear.text: A sleek wheelchair tailored for frequent adventuring, with mechanisms that let it traverse stairs and other obstacles common to adventuring sites.

gear.name: Wheelchair (Chair Storage)
gear.text: Stowage fitted to a wheelchair for carrying belongings.

gear.name: Adventurer's Pack
gear.text: Contains a backpack, bedroll, 10 pieces of chalk, flint and steel, 50 feet of rope, 2 weeks' rations, soap, 5 torches, and a waterskin.

gear.name: Grappling Hook
gear.text: You can throw a grappling hook with a rope tied to it to make a climb easier.

gear.name: Healer's Toolkit
gear.text: Bandages, herbs, and suturing tools. Required for Medicine checks to Administer First Aid, Treat Disease, Treat Poison, or Treat Wounds.

options.name: add a longsword and steel shield
